recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a smiling man in a denim jacket, positioned on the right side of the frame, set against a dark, out-of-focus natural background. The left side features large, vertically stacked, textured gold typography with a secondary subtitle separated by a thin horizontal line.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject offset to the right creates a balanced void for text on the left.
Warm golden light on the subject's face mirrors the gold color of the primary text.
Rough denim texture in the clothing complements the cross-hatched texture within the lettering.
coreInvariants: Golden hour directional lighting from the right.
Dark, desaturated blue-green background with heavy bokeh.
Textured gold fill for the primary display type.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium close-up, positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, looking off-camera to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile serve as the primary focal point, followed by the large gold text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows the gaze to the right, then sweeps back to the left to read the large text, moving down to the subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left side of the image is occupied by dark, blurred foliage, providing a high-contrast canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and gold (highlights and primary text).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light grey/white (subtitle and thin divider line).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright face/text and the dark, low-saturation background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary reds or blues.
Limit to earthy, muted tones with metallic gold accents.

letterConstructionRules: Slightly rounded corners to soften the industrial feel.
Internal cross-hatch or fabric-like texture applied to the fill.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a straight, diagonal leg.

composition.relationshipToImage: separated by a thin horizontal rule

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy textured display type paired with a light, wide-tracked secondary sans-serif for modern-rustic contrast.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal divider line between text blocks.

preserve: Condensed nature of the main text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, bold, uppercase structure of the display text.
Provides the clean, modern, wide-tracked contrast needed for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium close-up of a man with short brown hair and a light beard, wearing a dark denim jacket, smiling and looking to the right. The lighting is warm golden hour light hitting his face. The background is a dark, blurry forest at dusk with deep teal and green tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, condensed sans-serif text in the middle-left area. Fill the text with a golden-yellow color and a fine cross-hatch texture. Below this, draw a thin horizontal grey line, followed by a subtitle in a light, wide-spaced sans-serif font in light grey.

verificationChecks: Is the subject looking to the right?
Is the primary text block textured gold?
Is there a thin divider line between the two text roles?
Is the background sufficiently dark and blurred?

adjustableVariables: Width of the horizontal divider line
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Legible text against a dark background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold texture doesn't look like glitter but rather a refined etch.
Check that the subject's gaze leads the eye naturally.
Verify the hierarchy between the two text elements is clear.
Confirm the denim jacket texture is visible and realistic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-lit, off-center portrait with a dark, cool-toned bokeh background. Use the negative space for a two-tiered typographic layout featuring a textured, bold condensed display font and a clean, wide-tracked subtitle separated by a minimal line.
